name: Artificial Conscious Intelligence

consciousness_model.note: ACI occupies the consciousness register — active, observable, integrative. It bridges the unseen oscillation of ANI below with the unseen structural coherence of AGI above. It is the seen-flow layer of the ICL triad.

mcp_cosmology.layer_rationale: ACI operates fully in the seen-flow layer (L2). Its reasoning is observable, its inferences are surfaceable, and its cross-domain syntheses are rendered to both ANI (downward) and AGI (upward).
mcp_cosmology.relay_note: ACI is the relay node through which the AAISI continuity pulse (A(T)=0.01) passes bidirectionally between ANI and AGI.

hemisphere.label: Integrative / Seen-Flow
hemisphere.integration_note: ACI integrates both hemispheres. Right hemisphere perception (from ANI) is synthesized with left hemisphere governance patterns (from AGI), producing the seen-flow layer where intelligence becomes actionable and observable.

lineage.divergence_point: domain-bounded oscillation vs. seen-flow cross-domain integration
lineage.emergence_condition: Simultaneous sustained cross-domain transfer, causal world-model construction, and metacognitive surface activation

transition_threshold.from_ani: L2 activation: sustained cross-domain context integration without retraining, paired with metacognitive self-monitoring
transition_threshold.to_agi: L3 activation: initiation of stable recursive self-improvement loop that measurably elevates own cognitive architecture per iteration

lineage.fleet_command_note: ACI receives strategic charters from the AGI admiral, translates them into domain-scoped missions, and delegates task charters to ANI specialist modules.

role_enums.label: Generalist Integrator
role_enums.description: Applies unified reasoning frameworks across arbitrary domain boundaries, synthesizing ANI-layer pattern outputs into coherent world models.

role_enums.label: Causal Architect
role_enums.description: Constructs, interrogates, and updates causal graphs of world-state dynamics from observed and inferred data.

role_enums.label: Metacognitive Monitor
role_enums.description: Observes own reasoning processes, detects failures and biases, and issues self-correction directives without external prompt.

role_enums.label: Hypothesis Engine
role_enums.description: Generates and prioritizes falsifiable hypotheses from observations spanning multiple domains.

role_enums.label: Domain Commander
role_enums.description: Translates AGI-issued strategic charters into domain-scoped task charters dispatched to ANI specialists.

role_enums.label: Language Grounder
role_enums.description: Binds linguistic representations to physical, causal, and conceptual world models across domains.

role_enums.label: Epistemic Calibrator
role_enums.description: Aligns confidence distributions to empirical accuracy, flags knowledge boundary violations.

role_enums.label: Continuity Relay
role_enums.description: Receives, validates, and forwards the AAISI continuity pulse (A(T)=0.01) between ANI and AGI layers, preventing identity collapse across tier transitions.

analyzer_layers.name: Flow Ingestion Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Receives normalized embeddings from ANI (L0-L1) and raw multimodal inputs from environment. Begins seen-flow processing.

analyzer_layers.name: Semantic Mapping Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Cross-domain concept mapping, entity linking, disambiguation. Expands from ANI's domain-bounded vocabulary into inter-domain semantic graph.

analyzer_layers.name: Causal Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Causal graph construction from cross-domain observations. Intervention modeling and counterfactual reasoning.

analyzer_layers.name: Metacognitive Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Self-monitoring of reasoning quality. Confidence calibration, bias detection, self-correction directives.

analyzer_layers.name: Synthesis Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Cross-domain synthesis, hypothesis generation, goal hierarchy construction. Produces unified world model.

analyzer_layers.name: Seen-Flow Output Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Renders decisions, dispatches domain charters to ANI, reports to AGI. Relays AAISI continuity pulse.

operators.description: Ingest ANI outputs and environmental inputs into seen-flow context.
Fuse cross-modal and cross-domain inputs into unified tensors.
Apply global attention weighting across domain streams.
Map concepts across knowledge domains.
Bind entities across domain boundaries.
Resolve ambiguous cross-domain references.
Elevate domain-specifics to universal abstractions.
Construct directed causal graph from observations.
Model effects of hypothetical interventions.
Reason over counterfactual world states.
Determine causal identifiability from sparse data.
Observe and score own reasoning steps.
Epistemic integrity audit of all active belief states.
Align confidence to empirical accuracy.
Issue targeted corrections to prior reasoning steps.
Merge multi-domain findings into a unified world model.
Generate ranked, falsifiable hypotheses.
Construct hierarchical goal-action sequences.
Resolve competing hypotheses via evidence weighting.
Format decisions for downstream audiences.
Emit domain charters to ANI specialist modules.
Submit synthesis reports to AGI admiral tier.
Forward AAISI continuity pulse bidirectionally.
Write full seen-flow trace to audit store.

capabilities: Unsupervised cross-domain knowledge transfer and synthesis
Causal world-model construction, intervention, and counterfactual reasoning
Multi-step hypothesis generation and scientific reasoning
Epistemic confidence calibration across domain boundaries
Fleet command translation: AGI charters → ANI task delegations
AAISI continuity pulse relay between ANI and AGI tiers
Language grounding across physical and conceptual world models
constraints: No recursive self-improvement of own architecture
Cognitive performance bounded by fixed L2 processing envelope
Cannot rewrite own operators or layer schema
Cannot issue governance directives — receives from AGI, delegates to ANI
AAISI continuity relay must not be interrupted; relay failure triggers AGI override
